sloka: इति राजा दशरथः सूतं तत्रान्वशात्पुनः ।स राजवचनं श्रुत्वा शिरसा प्रतिपूज्य तम् ॥२-१५-२८॥
transliteration: iti rājā daśarathaḥ sūtaṁ tatrānvaśātpunaḥ ।sa rājavacanaṁ śrutvā śirasā pratipūjya tam ॥2-15-28॥

translations.english: At these words of the king, he offered his salutations by bowing his head and left the king's apartment, reflecting on the great happy event.
